name: Editorial / personal brand
one_liner: A confident, warm, magazine-style layout built around a named person and their point of view.

type_system.display: A serif or high-contrast display face for headlines, tracked tight, large (clamp to roughly 3rem-4.5rem).
type_system.body: A clean sans for body copy, generous line-height (1.5-1.6).
type_system.scale_note: Two sizes carry the page: the large serif headline and the body text. One mid-size for section headings.

color_approach: Warm neutral ground (cream, warm white), near-black ink, one restrained accent (a deep clay, rust, or forest tone) used only on the primary action and small marks.
layout_logic: Asymmetric two-column hero: headline and intro text on one side, a real portrait on the other, never centered. Sections below alternate text-led and image-led.
avoid: Centered hero, stock business photography, generic icon grid.

name: Modern minimal
one_liner: Restraint as the whole strategy: one message, one action, maximum whitespace.

type_system.display: A single clean sans, used at both display and body sizes — no second typeface.
type_system.body: Same family as display, lighter weight, comfortable size (16-18px).

color_approach: Near-white ground, near-black ink, one neutral mid-tone for secondary surfaces. Accent color is optional and used sparingly if at all.
layout_logic: Centered, narrow-measure hero with generous vertical space above and below. Content sections are simple single- or two-column grids with large gaps between sections.
avoid: Any gradient, any shadow, more than one accent color, dense multi-column layouts.

name: Modern corporate / B2B trust
one_liner: Structured hierarchy and trust signals for an audience evaluating credibility, not browsing for inspiration.

type_system.display: A confident sans, bold weight for headlines, moderate size (not oversized — trust reads as measured, not loud).
type_system.body: Same family, regular weight, high legibility.
type_system.scale_note: A clear heading/subheading/body hierarchy — more structural than expressive.

color_approach: White or very light neutral ground, dark ink, a single corporate accent (commonly a blue) used consistently for every action and link.
layout_logic: Image-led or balanced split hero, structured card grids for services, a dedicated proof/trust section (clients, numbers, credentials) placed prominently.
avoid: Playful or expressive type, more than one accent color, anything that reads as casual.

name: Creative studio / bold
best_for: anyone wanting to feel confident, not safe
one_liner: Oversized type and a near-black canvas with one vivid accent color, built to feel distinctive rather than corporate.

type_system.display: A heavy-weight sans, set very large (headline can dominate the entire first screen).
type_system.body: Same family, lighter weight, kept small and quiet relative to the display size.
type_system.scale_note: Extreme contrast between display and body sizes is the point.

color_approach: Near-black ground, off-white ink, one genuinely vivid accent (not a gradient — a single flat saturated color) used for the primary action and small marks only.
layout_logic: Full-bleed, wide hero imagery; project/work grids with minimal chrome around each item, letting the work itself carry the visual weight.
avoid: Pastel or muted colors, small/timid type, generic icon decoration.

name: Premium / luxury
best_for: anything that needs to feel exclusive and unhurried
one_liner: A dark, quiet canvas with a thin metallic accent and a centered, patient hero — nothing competes for attention.

type_system.display: A refined serif for the headline, moderate size, generous letter-spacing on supporting labels.
type_system.body: A plain sans for body copy, kept small and quiet.
type_system.scale_note: Restraint over scale — luxury reads as unhurried, not loud.

color_approach: Near-black ground, warm off-white ink, a single thin gold/bronze accent used only on borders and small marks, never as a fill.
layout_logic: Centered hero with large surrounding negative space. Single large atmospheric image beneath the fold. Gallery sections use generous spacing between items, no visible card chrome.
avoid: Bright or saturated color, dense grids, visible borders/shadows on cards.

name: Product-confident
best_for: physical or digital products with genuinely strong photography
one_liner: One dominant product image and one claim per screen — inspired by how Apple paces a product page, applied to a completely different product.

type_system.display: A clean, very confident sans, large, one claim per screen.
type_system.body: Same family, short supporting sentence — never a paragraph on the first screen of a section.
type_system.scale_note: Two sizes: the claim, and the short supporting line. Nothing competes with the product image.

color_approach: White or one flat deep color per section (not a wash of gray) — color changes deliberately section to section, chosen to flatter the product image, not decorate the UI.
layout_logic: One large, well-lit product image per scroll stop, paired with one short claim. Sections reveal one idea at a time rather than stacking multiple claims together.
avoid: Multiple claims per screen, generic UI iconography standing in for the actual product, busy backgrounds competing with the product image.

name: Commerce-energetic
one_liner: Restraint plus energy — alternating flat-color sections and specific, concrete proof rather than abstract claims.

type_system.display: A friendly but confident sans, bold for headlines.
type_system.body: Same family, regular weight, comfortable reading size.
type_system.scale_note: Clear two-level hierarchy; approachable rather than austere.

color_approach: Alternating flat-color section backgrounds (not a uniform gray page) to create rhythm as the visitor scrolls — one neutral section, one bold-color section, repeating.
layout_logic: Each section makes one specific, concrete claim backed by a real number or real example — never an abstract claim with no proof. One clear CTA per section, high contrast.
avoid: Abstract marketing claims with no specific backing, a uniform gray page with no rhythm, competing CTAs within one section.
